notes.title: Drilling deeper STILL into the making of Oil Strike '75
notes.content:
Today, we're pleased to share the concluding episodes #3 and #4 of the Oil Strike '75 developer diary series, and the project's ties to to this year's celebrated narrative-horror [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622910/Still_Wakes_the_Deep/]Still Wakes the Deep[/url]. 

If you didn't catch the first two Oil Strike '75 developer diaries from the Sumo Digital Academy in October, make sure to visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2740090/view/4515513423578356837?l=english]previous post to see the origins of the Sumo Digital Academy's project[/url].

Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=MUNHrRWn948;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=LQt5LUyZ6hI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you've any questions for the team, please leave them in the comments below and we'd be happy to answer them.

notes.title: Drill deeper into the making of Oil Strike '75
notes.content:
In August we admitted the big secret: Oil Strike '75 was developed by the Sumo Digital Academy, and players who bury beneath the surface will discover more than a few references to this year's celebrated narrative-horror [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622910/Still_Wakes_the_Deep/]Still Wakes the Deep[/url].

For those of you curious about the origins of Oil Strike '75, the development team has been chronicling its efforts in a series of dev diaries, and the first two episodes are available now:

[previewyoutube=9CZ_ZawNpm8;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=90qhzlcyg7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

If you've any questions for the team, please leave them in the comments below. And be sure to check back next month to watch the concluding parts of Oil Strike '75's creation.

notes.title: It's time we come clean about Oil Strike '75
notes.content:
The secret's been spilled!

Today we're confirming what many of you discovered: that Oil Strike '75 is a companion title to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622910/Still_Wakes_the_Deep/]Still Wakes the Deep[/url], developed by the 2023/2024 cohort of the Sumo Digital Academy.

To drill beneath the surface of Oil Strike '75's development and read about how it came together, read the full reveal over [url=https://www.sumo-digital.com/news-insights/sumo-digital-academy-reveals-work-on-oil-strike-75/ ]on our website.[/url]
